proof_body:
by
  intro R K _ _ _ _ _ x h
  let D : Ideal R := (LinearMap.range (Algebra.linearMap R K)).colon ({x} : Set K)
  have hmem : ∀ s : R, s ∈ D ↔ ∃ a : R, algebraMap R K a = algebraMap R K s * x := by
    intro s
    simp [D, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Algebra.smul_def]
  have hD : D = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal D hne
    obtain ⟨a, s, hs, hsa⟩ := h P hP
    exact hs (hle ((hmem s).mpr ⟨a, hsa.symm⟩))
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (hmem 1).mp (hD ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  exact ⟨a, by simpa using ha⟩
target_source: ∀ (R K : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (x : K), (∀ (P : Ideal R) (_ : P.IsMaximal), ∃ a s : R, s ∉ P ∧ algebraMap R K s * x = algebraMap R K a) → ∃ r : R, algebraMap R K r = x
